routing_smart_desc: Routes only blocked traffic through the VPN
no_servers_available: No servers available. Connect first to choose a location.
routing_note: Smart Routing uses region-specific rules to automatically send traffic that needs the VPN through Spark. All other traffic goes direct for speed and reliability.

unbounded_help_banner: Turn your device into a bridge. When Unbounded is on, people in censored regions can route their traffic through you to reach the open internet.
unbounded_helping_now: People you are helping right now
unbounded_auto_enable_sub: Start helping automatically whenever Spark is running.
unbounded_welcome_body: Unbounded lets your device act as a digital bridge for people living under censorship. When you turn it on, their traffic flows through your connection to the open internet. It's entirely optional, and you can turn it off any time.
